description: Highlight elements on page. Supports single or multiple candidates (refs) with styles ('consideration' for candidate evaluation, 'target' for lock-on, 'danger' for destructive actions, 'success', or 'shimmer'), floating badges, and configurable duration.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

color.description: Custom CSS color to use for the overlay (e.g. 'rgba(255,0,0,0.5)').

duration.description: Duration in ms to keep highlight visible (default: 2000ms for consideration/target, 600ms for shimmer).

id.description: Alternative element Ref ID from browser_map (e.g. 'w:42').

label.description: Floating label badge text to display above the element(s).

refs.description: Array of element Ref IDs to highlight concurrently (e.g. ['w:12', 'w:15', 'w:23']).

selector.description: CSS Selector of the element to highlight.

style.description: Visual highlight style. Defaults to 'shimmer' (or 'consideration' when refs provided).

target.description: Alternative element identifier, CSS Selector, or query.

name: browser_highlight
